clips.title: The story
paras: At Algaz Station, Mountaineers guard the northern road from Loch Modan toward the Wetlands. The outpost lies south of Dun Algaz, where the pass leads through the mountains.

At Algaz Station, dwarven Mountaineers watch the road north from Loch Modan. The post lies east of North Gate Pass and south of Dun Algaz, guarding the route between the kingdom of Ironforge and the northern lowlands. The road carries trade and troops through the mountain tunnels, but the hills bring danger from wandering beasts and troggs. Mountaineers keep the way open and offer weary travelers a place for respite, repairs, and martial support before they enter the pass.
